mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the backup by restoring the map correction was worthwhile: it demonstrated what could actually be recovered while acknowledging what the test could not answer.

leastWorthwhile.text: Attaching the cartridge to the cradle felt like a procedural transition rather than an interesting decision, although its read-only connection had a clear purpose.

surprise.text: Moth's question about whether the copy was really itself gave a routine backup an unresolved personal dimension.

arbitrary.text: No action felt entirely purposeless; attaching the backup to the cradle was the least intuitive fitting, but the result explained why it was there.

continue.text: Yes. I would be curious to see how Moth and the neighbors use their repaired infrastructure, though this chapter's combinations were fairly predictable.
